question: Where were the 2022 Winter Olympic Games held?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Beijing".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Beijing became the **first city **which has hosted **both summer and winter Olympic games.**
 
• This was the 24th edition of the winter Olympic games.
 
• The closing ceremony of these games took place at** Bird's Nest stadium **on February 20, 2022.
 
• **Three zones** across which game venues were distributed - were **Beijing, Yanqing, and Zhangjiakou.**
 
• **Norway **won the maximum number of medals in these Olympics.
 
• **Germany** took second place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Current affairs related to games:
 
 
• The US boycotted the 2022 Winter Olympics.
 
• Commonwealth Games 2022 was hosted by** Birmingham.**
 
• The Asia cup 2022 was hosted by** UAE.**
 
• **India was ranked fourth** in the 22nd commonwealth games 2022.
 
• **Asian games** are organized after every **four** years.
